shots.label: frontal_neutral
shots.prompt: @satoshi. Preserve the exact same person: same facial geometry, age, hairline, hair texture, eye color, skin tone, nose, jaw, ears and overall build. Photorealistic frontal medium-close portrait, direct gaze into camera, neutral intelligent expression, understated evidence-studio wardrobe, even natural studio lighting, simple neutral background. Do not beautify, age, de-age, or change identity. One person only.

shots.label: three_quarter_neutral
shots.prompt: @satoshi. Preserve the exact same person and identity. Photorealistic three-quarter medium-close portrait turned about 30 degrees, eyes toward camera, neutral intelligent expression, same understated wardrobe family and natural evidence-studio lighting. Same age, hairline, facial structure, skin, eyes and build. One person only.
